job.meaning: генеральный директор международной компании: мужчина ~42, бритая голова, очки в тонкой оправе, тёмная водолазка; фотореализм, по пояс, оба плеча в кадре с запасом, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки, однотонный светло-серый фон, без надписей
job.person_note: the person described in the prompt
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of a real-looking, charismatic CEO of a mid-size international company — a vivid recognisable character, confident and approachable, NOT a fashion model, NOT a stock photo. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, the person in the centre, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous empty margin (at least 12% of the width) on the left and right, elbows visible, hands relaxed in front at waist level holding nothing; nothing cropped at the sides. Headroom: the top of the head about 14% of the frame height below the upper edge; the face is large and sharp. Expression: attentive eyes, the face NEUTRAL like in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Background: a plain seamless light warm-grey backdrop #D9D6D0, soft even studio light, natural skin texture. No text, no logos, no badges, no brand names, nothing covering the face, no headphones. A man of about 42, Slavic features, shaved head, thin metal-rimmed glasses, short stubble, a dark navy merino turtleneck under an unstructured grey blazer.
